title: Solving Equations: One-Step, Two-Step, Multi-Step | Algebra I, Unit 2, Part 1
description:
Learn to solve linear equations from the ground up. Start with the balance idea and inverse operations for one-step equations, undo operations in reverse order for two-step equations, then use a four-step plan for multi-step equations with distributing and variables on both sides. Finish with equations that have no solution or infinitely many solutions. Each section ends with a practice problem.
